title.narrative: Strengthening gender equality at work in Mexico

description.narrative:
Develop a guide for companies to transform their traditional recruitment and selection processes for non-discriminatory and equal opportunity processes or a methodology to measure the gender pay gap.
This study intends to contribute in the field of gender equality and decent jobs in Mexico where women and men struggle to secure good quality jobs and achieve work-life balance. Compared to workers in other OECD countries, Mexicans also spend very long hours in paid work. The culture of long paid hours, combined with Mexican women’s disproportionate responsibility for unpaid work, reinforces gendered outcomes in the labour market and at home.
The project proposed by the Gender Equality Policies Area of EUROsociAL has the long-term goal of advancing gender equality in the workplace at the federal and state level, as well as among Danish companies based in Mexico.
However, the project also has several short-term outcomes such as the elaboration of a guide or manual for companies to transform their traditional recruitment or establishing a dialogue table or a cooperation protocol between several Danish companies located in Mexico.
